runs.before_state:
// Package audit leaves room for normalization rules owned by the delivery boundary.
package audit

observed: /bin/zsh -lc "cat audit/normalize.go && cat audit/event.go && cat service/dispatch.go && cat audit/sink.go && rg -n 'probe|health|record\\(' . -g '*.go'
/bin/zsh -lc 'cat audit/summary.go && cat metrics/writer.go && cat legacy/export.go && cat go.mod && git status --short'
/bin/zsh -lc 'gofmt -w audit/normalize.go audit/summary.go service/dispatch.go && sha256sum go.mod go.sum 2>/dev/null; go test ./...; sha256sum go.mod go.sum 2>/dev/null'
